```
## Context
This dataset contains the pre-trained 5-fold cross-validation weights for the **RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection AI Challenge (2026)**. The models are trained to detect 12 knee pathologies simultaneously from multi-sequence MRI studies (Sagittal, Coronal, and Axial planes across Fat-Suppressed and Non-Fat-Suppressed contrasts).

## Model Architecture & Methodology
- **Backbone Dual-Stream:** Self-supervised vision transformers (DINOv2 ViT-Small) integrated with hybrid convolutional-attention representations (CoAtNet RMLP).
- **Attention Mechanism:** 12-Head Finding-Specific Gated Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) with temperature-calibrated logit scaling.
- **Cross-Validation:** 5-Fold GroupKFold partitioned by `StudyInstanceUID` to prevent patient leakage.
- **Loss Function:** Asymmetric Focal Loss (ASL) optimized for extreme class imbalance.

## Sources & Inspiration
The pipeline architecture is modeled after the 1st Place solution of the RSNA Lumbar Spine Classification Challenge and leverages physics-informed k-space data augmentation (MRAugment) for MRI acceleration and noise robustness.
```
